_comment: Stage-3 regions. Each region owns the listed pads (VCC3V3 unless the net is given) and works inside its box; it starts from the trunk's tap of the same name (taps.json written by the chosen trunk). max_mA is the datasheet-maximum current the region draws through its tap (docs/power_budget.md). The trunk designer must end a track at every tap.

west.note: the header corner: X2-17 (TH) and its caps at y 21.4, the R34 array at y 18.39; the source island C80-2/L1-2/U5-4 is in this box too

sdled.note: the SD socket pin X3-4 (Top, 200 mA card), BTN and LD5 (TH), the 0201 pull-ups at y 18.75-19.35, U10-8 (Bottom); the LED lanes and USB5V0 already run here

north.note: U2's north pins 50 (VREGIN, 70 mA) and 56 (VCCIO) at y 19.3, U2-42 (VCCIO, east side y 14.35), U3's north VDDQ pads 43/49 (Bottom y 17.53), the LED resistors R80-R82 (Bottom y 19.05); X1 (USB, TH) sits at x 29.5-36.5 y 21.3-24

south.note: the cap row (0603 at y 3.05, 0201 at y 3.95), the beads' VCC3V3 ends L4-2/L5-2, U3's south VDD/VDDQ pads (Bottom y 6.17), U2's south VCCIO pins 20/31 (Top y 7.9, reachable only at 0.163 / 0.538 mm today); VU and VBATT run on Top here, the SDRAM bus on L3/L4

u1field.note: the 17 VCCO islands (one ball named per island; each island's via is in stage3_facts.md) and the twelve 0201s on the y 7.65 / 11.05 / 14.45 rows; Bottom only inside the land field; VCC1V0 owns the north strip y 15.935 and the east flank x 50.23; the AIN bundle runs down the west strip

northbank.note: the 0201 row at y 17.85, the 0603 bank at y 21.1 / 22.4 (Bottom), Q1 (Top, 12 MHz oscillator) and U4-8 (Top, flash); VCC1V0's C87/C88 columns run at x 44.3 and 47.4

east.note: the 1206 caps C97/C98/C145/C146 (Top), the south-east pull-ups and JP4-3 (TH), the north-east pull-ups, R4-8 (Top), J1-6/12 (TH Pmod, user current); VCC1V0's 22 uF bank and VCC1V8's L4 run sit at x 53-58

ft.note: routed AFTER the south region, with the trunk and the south plan as base copper; no VCC3V3 tap -- these are their own nets
